objectives: Decode taught sl-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sl onset with the vowel and ending.
Distinguish sl from other taught consonant blends.
Reread to repair a missed grapheme and check the complete word.
concepts: Decoding maps graphemes to sounds in order.
The sl onset contains s then l.
The vowel and final consonant also carry information.
Rereading checks the full written word.
